adaptation: Original14October asset bundle is absent and is not searched. Current fixed512 downloaded training cohort replaces old224 cohort; frozen before any new tiny results. This is a new-protocol conversion, not replication of old simulation scores.

pure_variant.source: Only accepted PTQ or bounded QAT output with full89 float-parent construction parity
pure_variant.host_input: np.clip(np.rint(image / np.float32(scale)), -127, 127).astype(np.int8); zero point must be zero

pure_variant.ties: Count actual integer output ties, new ties, and argmax changes. Shared positive scale does not guarantee argmax preservation after rounding.
pure_variant.logits: Record strict logit agreement; edge-zero graph changes are admitted by the existing accuracy tolerance, not assumed exact.
pure_variant.make_float_variant: Pinned supplied tool only; never used to reconstruct the genuine float parent
